g.title: leaf
g.text: Static call graph of src/*.c, as written (direct calls only; no call through a pointer, no recursion)
Read from left to right: the entry points of include/ztl/leaf.h (bold) call to the right. Blue: protocol (leaf.c); orange: receive gate; violet: cryptography; green: decoders.

Not drawn: 14 small helpers called from many places (begin, leaf.c:count, zero, ztl_age_ms, ztl_be16, ztl_be32, ztl_bytes_eq, ztl_copy_bytes, ztl_le32, ztl_put_be16, ztl_put_be32, ztl_put_le32, ztl_wipe, ztl_wipe32)
